name: VASTlint
tagline: Validate VAST, VMAP, and DAAST ad tags against IAB specs
description: Hosted MCP for IAB VAST, VMAP, and DAAST tag validation. Public tools (validate_vast, validate_vast_url, inspect_vast, list_rules, explain_rule, fix_vast) require no auth. Paste XML or pass a live tag URL. Returns rule IDs, severities, XPath locations, and spec references.

install.notes: Public tools need no login. Auth none.
